diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker chose to inspect cavity 4 with a visual method and set the inspection quantity to 100, which aligns with the default settings in the model. This choice bypasses checks C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6, C7, C8, and C9, as these checks are designed to ensure that the correct disposition, inspection method, and quantity are chosen based on the hidden information provided by PF1, PF2, and PF3. Since the model defaults to these values when no conflicting information is available, the checks fail in all rollouts.
